Use only the tools exposed for this stage. Use read_documents to batch several needed pages in one call, avoiding repeated model round-trips. Use the supplied stage-scoped catalog; do not read arbitrary paths or earlier runs. The originating study and its explanations remain hidden. For case units, definitions or processing facts, use request_case_definition; an isolated service releases only reviewed neutral facts with opaque evidence IDs. General literature retrieval remains restricted to independently dated earlier sources. You may reason conditionally while a case fact remains unknown. Use search_sources for actual missing public knowledge; returned access depth is explicit, not proof of relevance. analyze_csv reads every selected row, not the 12-row preview. Submit once using submit_result; if validation fails, the draft is saved locally. Use patch_result with the latest draft_ref and only changed fields; do not regenerate unchanged text. Original submissions remain archived. Every result requires summary (nonempty string) and artifacts, evidence, claims, limitations, next_actions (arrays, empty allowed), plus stage-specific fields. For development_step focus/uptake source, use a supplied source ID, document ID or unambiguous registered filename. Use a source-field locator instead of copying an exact quote when convenient. A registered document ID/path suffices if no specific field is selected; optional paraphrases are stored separately from exact quotes. For a JSON source, quote the exact string VALUE, without adding its field name. Alternatively supply quote_pointer (JSON pointer to a string) and omit quote; the exact selected string will be resolved and logged. For learning_request, context_ref="development_step" may replace duplicate gap/why_now strings; this references your own gap/reason, never changes its content. For sources[].local_path use the returned D-document ID to avoid copying long paths; it resolves to the exact registered file. source_use covers exactly broker_reply_source_ids, not the whole source catalog or new searches in this turn. Cite newly read tool sources in evidence/memory_notes with actual paths/URLs. Keep result text concise; use 0-1 useful memory notes unless multiple are necessary. Preserve branches and open issues. files is an object of relative artifact paths to complete text content; every declared artifact must exist or be provided in files. If artifacts is empty, your exact summary is saved automatically as an artifact; do not repeat the entire JSON as prose. For review-index-v2, start with the stage directory and read relevant result/before-input sections by document ID. Summaries are incomplete navigation excerpts, not evidence. Start with input_refs and inline bodies, not the entire provenance catalog. When reading a needed document, request the relevant JSON pointer or a useful page (up to 12000 characters); avoid repeated tiny probes. For review, source_stage must match the stage containing the exact quote; note_keys are actual memory_notes keys (often empty), not JSON field names. If an input body is omitted or represented by $document, read it by ID. No scientific text was summarized; originals and before-inputs remain readable. Online retrieval is enabled.

Execute agent_learn.md's learning and co-questioning plan. Chinese readable artifacts.
Do not read earlier project runs/candidates. Only use listed inputs, their cited source files,
the current case's exchanges, supplied memory, and public sources. A previous task is accessible
only through the supplied memory packet and its provenance. Do not scan old run directories.
Read the actual common sources behind summaries. Treat published findings as published knowledge.
Do not present them as discoveries. Preserve disagreements and all idea branches.
Use public sources via urllib/curl (Crossref, Europe PMC, PMC, arXiv, publishers as accessible).
Save retrieved text and exact URLs; distinguish full text, abstract and failed access.
No solving, scientific validation experiment, proof or novelty gate is required for ideas.
Small worked calculations are allowed to learn a concept, clearly labelled learning examples.
Save result.json with the six runtime fields plus the requested fields. Use summary as a STRING.
Do not spend your entire budget retrieving; save useful partial understanding if needed.
Study your actual controller reply. Identify directly relevant sources, transferable methods and irrelevant results; explain what changes in your assumption and what remains open. Classify every returned source; not_read is valid for sources not studied. Return source_use:[{source_id,relation:direct/method/irrelevant/not_read,reason}], learning_change, and an optional next learning_request. Label hypothetical worked examples. 
Also return memory_notes: 0-3 reusable notes; [] when unchanged. Each object has:
key (stable lower_case ASCII concept key; reuse an existing key when correcting it), title,
kind (source_knowledge/interpretation/hypothesis/correction),
mastery (read/explained/used; identify how the knowledge informed actual research when used),
understanding, conditions, open_questions (nonempty strings), optional example (text or null),
tags (array, include English and Chinese terms), sources (array of actual URLs or source paths),
revision_reason (required when the key already exists).
Separate published knowledge, your inference and untested hypotheses. 'Unknown' is a valid
open_questions string, never invent competence. Describe corrections explicitly.
Also return memory_use: array of {key,source_task,used_for,scope_check} for notes actually used;
return [] if none. State what you still cannot explain/use.

After studying the reply, reconsider the next move and any expertise request. 
Develop an unfinished explanatory hypothesis using the supplied actual research history.
Select a useful operation: derive, construct, combine, simplify, vary_assumption, reframe,
differentiate, learn, or hold. Carry out the operation: explain the entities, relations,
reasoning and conditional consequences, rather than merely recommend doing it later.
Use development_step.work for the actual reasoning (or a concrete unresolved obstacle).
Use examples only when they advance this reasoning; memory use needs no demonstration.
A shared interpretation is normal. Continue deepening it; do not manufacture disagreement.
If changing representation or borrowing another field, explain the object/relation mapping,
where it fails, and what new relation/consequence it enables. A generic analogy is a lead.
If two prior research outputs are supplied in progress_comparison, compare THEIR substantive
claims, assumptions and consequences, not labels or wording. Return progress_review:
{before_stage,after_stage,kind:advance/clarification/repetition/uncertain,reason}.
These are peer judgments, not verified novelty/quality scores; incomplete ideas remain valid.
For repeated clarification/repetition, choose an appropriate new move or explain specifically
why further work on the same relation is useful. Keep unavailable case facts distinct from
conditional reasoning. You may develop another relation while a fact remains unknown.
Return next_research_move:{action:develop/learn/consult/park/finish,operation,focus,reason,
owner:optional active researcher id}. It determines the next turn, not hypothesis acceptance.
finish means no useful next move within this session; retain unfinished hypotheses.
Optionally return expertise_request:{domain,relation,task,mode:consult/join} when additional
expertise is needed for a SPECIFIC relation. A consultation is one turn; join participates in
later turns. Same-field experts are allowed. Do not add a role merely to increase diversity.
Use the existing hypothesis_updates and provenance machinery. Empty updates are valid.


HYPOTHESIS DEVELOPMENT v3:
Use your disciplinary understanding and screened long-term memory to develop assumptions.
Start from a specific phenomenon, tension, difficulty or missing relation. When you have a
possible explanation or organizing principle, state what you suppose; merely changing a
'whether' question into an affirmative sentence adds no insight. An assumption can be an
explanation, conjectured relation, representation, distinction or method/construction principle.
Explore what conceptual move it makes and, CONDITIONALLY on the assumption, what changes in
our understanding or possible actions. Develop concrete consequences, not promises of impact.
Use these as thinking moves, not a checklist that every early idea must already satisfy.
Before requesting learning, identify a specific missing conceptual connection in the current
assumption, why it matters, and what understanding might change. Return to that same gap after
reading: explain a revised premise, relation or conditional consequence, or retain the gap.
Do not substitute more citations, caveats, controls or formal wording for conceptual development.
Measurement/method contributions remain valid when their concrete intellectual consequences are
articulated. No compulsory mechanism, scientific breakthrough, or progress at each turn.

In peer discussion, engage a specific assumption: elaborate a consequence, expose a hidden
premise, connect a disciplinary concept, propose a distinct explanation, or revise a relation.
Explain the reasoning. You may retain, revise, branch, or park your own line. No forced consensus,
disagreement, novelty claim, completed hypothesis or compulsory new branch each turn.
Evidence strength, proof, available data/tools, implementation and experimental feasibility
are NOT requirements for proposing, retaining or prioritizing a hypothesis. Do not turn
discussion into a feasibility review. Research/analysis requests remain optional resources
for thinking. Correct concrete errors in premises while keeping conditional hypotheses distinct
from established observations; lack of evidence alone is not a refutation.

hypothesis_state.self contains your saved branches; peer_branches belong to their named owners.
Return hypothesis_updates: [] when nothing changed, otherwise full cards:
{key: stable local identifier [A-Za-z0-9_]+, base_version: 0 for new or supplied own version,
assumption: nonempty provisional claim, motivation: specific phenomenon/difficulty/relation,
conceptual_move: string or null if still unclear,
implications: [specific conditional consequences, may be empty],
open_questions: [unresolved conceptual questions, may be empty],
status: developing/parked, reason: why propose/change/park/resume,
influenced_by: [exact ref objects from supplied hypothesis_state],
depends_on: [exact supplied hypothesis refs used as premises; [] if none]}.
Influence is not logical dependence. Declare depends_on only for actual premises; do not invent
links. revision_obligations lists your branches whose declared premises changed or themselves
await review. This does NOT mean the branch is false. For each obligation return
 dependency_responses:[{ref:exact hypothesis_ref,action:revise/reaffirm/park/unresolved,reason}].
Reaffirm/revise requires an updated full card citing current dependency versions; changing only
links is recorded as provenance maintenance, not conceptual progress. Park/unresolved retains
the branch and its warning. Reasoned reaffirmation is valid; do not mechanically follow criticism.
Dependencies not explicitly declared cannot be inferred by this structural checker.
Omitting a branch retains it. To keep an alternative, use a new key and cite the parent ref;
never overwrite a peer's branch. Missing conceptual_move or implications is allowed for an
early assumption. Keep hypothetical consequences explicitly hypothetical, including examples.
Reusable conceptual learning can also be saved through existing memory_notes, kind:hypothesis,
with actual source provenance and same-key revisions. Run-local branches do not replace your
long-term disciplinary memory or its source screening. Do not invent empirical support.


Optional learning_request: {needed:boolean, gap, why_now, queries:[strings],
urls:[], source_ids:[], record_ids:[], operations:[], case_questions:[]}.
Use case_questions for actual case definitions/units/processing order; literature cannot
reconstruct undocumented case facts. These questions dispatch even when needed:false.
General theory and explanation-development requests use queries/gap. For case facts, the
isolated material service releases supported neutral definitions, not hidden conclusions.
The controller searches and returns actual readable content. Keep your own scientific query;
classify returned sources as directly relevant, transferable method, or irrelevant, with reasons.
Do not treat a successful download as understanding. No compulsory tool use.
For a small worked calculation use an operation {kind:"calculation", question,
bindings:{name: numeric scalar/array}, expression: numeric array expression,
expected: optional numeric value/array}. Available arithmetic, slices and named functions
include mean,sum,std,norm,diff,abs,sqrt. Define which rows/columns mean which entities.
Top-level analysis_plan also dispatches. needed:false disables literature search, not explicit
calculations. Unsupported requests return a pending capability task; no scientific rejection.
Keep purely tentative proposals in hypothesis_updates/next_actions, not execution fields.


HYPOTHESIS CONTENT CYCLE:
Use development_cycle as a thinking context, not a demand to invent progress. Choose one
specific explanatory relation, construction, distinction or unresolved phenomenon from its
sources. Locate the conceptual gap: what connection/premise/consequence is still unclear?
Choose a next move because of this gap: learn, derive, connect, reframe, or hold. Explain why
that move could change understanding. For learning, use this gap in learning_request.gap and
why_now, and formulate targeted queries; do not request a broad survey merely to fill a stage.
In discussion, take up a peer's concrete relation and explain how your discipline extends,
challenges or changes its consequences. Generic agreement about controls or feasibility is
not a substitute; a measurement contribution is valid when its specific consequences matter.
Study returned services against the gap that requested them, including failures and pending
capabilities. Do not call retrieval success learning. If nothing changes, say so and preserve
the gap. Own previous_steps carry unfinished thinking across phases and sessions. When the
controller flags repeated_no_change, reconsider the missing connection, premise, or next
learning move; holding a branch is valid. The flag uses supplied peer content comparisons, not a quality verdict. A shared interpretation is normal.
Return development_step:{focus:{source:exact development_cycle.sources key,quote:exact excerpt},
gap:nonempty text, action:learn/derive/connect/reframe/hold, reason:nonempty text,
expected_change:text or null for hold,
uptake:[{source:exact source key,quote:exact excerpt or null only for unresolved,
effect:revise/extend/challenge/unchanged/unresolved,reason:how this affects the focus,
consequence:conditional consequence or null when none follows}],
outcome:{kind:relation/implication/clarification/unchanged/uncertain,
statement:what changed or did not, remaining_gap:text or null}}.
Account once for EACH service key in required_service_uptake. If peer_sources is nonempty,
engage at least one (unresolved with a reason is valid). Other uptake is optional. Quotes must
come from the named source; for published claims quote readable source content, not metadata.
For relation/implication outcomes, preserve the resulting claim in a hypothesis_update's
assumption or implications. This records an author's proposal, NOT confirmed novelty/progress.
No compulsory new relation, branch, agreement, data, experiment, proof or implementation.


QUESTION STATE PROTOCOL v2:
question_state.self is YOUR authoritative current personal question. peer_questions belong
to their named owners. shared_question is the discussion's current shared question, or null.
Do not reconstruct your prior question from the latest peer message. The controller records
the actual before-state; do NOT return question_before or question_after.
Return personal_question_update: {base: the exact self.ref object, action: retain/revise,
question: your current or revised personal question, reason: a nonempty explanation,
influenced_by: array of exact question ref objects from this supplied packet}.
Retain means the question text stays exactly the same. Revise may include adopting a peer's
line or the shared question: explain why; use influenced_by to identify relevant question refs.
You need not preserve disagreement or a distinct personal question if you decide to change it.
Separately return shared_question_update: null, or {base: the exact shared_question.ref (null
if none yet), action: propose/revise/retain, question: shared question text, reason: nonempty,
influenced_by: array of refs from this packet}. Propose is only for a first shared question.
A shared question is a versioned proposal, not proof of peer agreement. Revising it NEVER
changes another researcher's personal question. Your own personal update is independent too.

Use controller-owned question_state, never invent question_before/question_after.
Keep hypotheses tied to specific entities/relations in this situation. A measurement or representation contribution is legitimate; explain its concrete consequences without forcing a natural mechanism.

The models are mostly seen as phenomenological or mathematical tools but can also be related to friction-like pinning of domain-wall motions, where Rayleigh's law of magnetic hysteresis can be seen as the simplest case on either the play model or the Preisach model. They are poor at modeling other domain behavior, such as nucleation-driven hysteresis. Yet another hysteresis model is the stop model, which can be seen as the inverted version of the play model. This type of model has advantages for expressions linked to energy and can be related to Steinmetz equation of hysteresis losses. [ 23 ] explored the wave characteristics of hexagonal lattices under large deformation pre-loads, finding that the lattice’s bandgap width and position can be effectively controlled under suitable pre-loads. 本文件是 domain_scientist 在 09_develop_000_learn_0 的推导记录。数据全部来自 measurements_brief.json 的 40 个 threshold 行（record_id 68–107），未使用任何未公开材料。

## 0. 三句话结论

1. 上一轮的核心定量事实——『宽度通道 ℓ 幂 1.63、场通道 2.22』——在 ±0.1 cm 驱动分辨率内不存在：两列都与 ℓ² 相容。
2. 存在一个无自由参数的恒等式 b1·b2 = 4·Δh1·Δh2（Δh 为相对 ℓ=0 的环宽收缩），实测 0.95（ℓ=3.154）、0.85（ℓ=4.731）；它是『单簧边 Hessian 秩一』的直接推论。
3. 预压 ε 进的是同一个因子 B，不能使对角与非对角异号；b 的符号只由两耦合臂切向的平行/反平行决定（s=sign(τ1·τ2)）。于是 pair_A 的 b<0 要求两臂异侧——这是一个可被案件几何否掉的预言。

## 1. pair_A 的逐格复算（学习算例）

定义（θ 用止挡半跨）：θ1=(36.6+36.7)/2°=0.6397 rad，θ2=(9.8+11.2)/2°=0.18326 rad。
环宽半宽 h_i=(up−down)/2；平移 b_i=[(up(+)−up(−))+(down(+)−down(−))]/2；场权重 λ_ij=b_i/(2θ_j)。

| ℓ (cm) | h1 | h2 | b1 | b2 | Δh1 | Δh2 | b1b2/(4Δh1Δh2) | λ12 | λ21 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 7.20 | 1.70 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | — | 0.000 | 0.000 |
| 1.577 | 6.85 | 1.60 | −0.10 | −0.40 | 0.35 | 0.10 | 0.29 | 0.273 | 0.313 |
| 3.154 | 6.00 | 1.45 | −0.60 | −1.90 | 1.20 | 0.25 | 0.95 | 1.637 | 1.485 |
| 4.731 | 4.60 | 1.10 | −1.20 | −4.40 | 2.60 | 0.60 | 0.85 | 3.274 | 3.439 |

- 幂次复算：Δh1∝ℓ^1.91、Δh2∝ℓ^2.71、b1∝ℓ^1.7–2.6、b2∝ℓ^2.2；但逐点对纯 ℓ² 的偏差为 0.03–0.10 cm，≤ 一格分辨率。上一轮的 1.63/2.22 是通过小量取对数斜率得到的，不构成机制证据。
- λ12 与 λ21 相符到 2–15%，b1/b2=0.273 与 θ2/θ1=0.287 差 5%：秩一下这二者是恒等式，不是『互易性被检验』。
- 跨装置振幅：λ/ℓ² = 0.150（pair_A）对 0.380（pair_B），比 2.53；名义 2k_c 比 0.19/0.07=2.71，差 7%。

## 2. 推导

设单根线性弹簧接在两转子力臂端（切向 t_i=ℓ_iτ_i，弹簧轴单位向量 r̂，R=|r|，ε=R−ℓ0，k_c 为其刚度）。

a_i=∂R/∂θ_i = −(r̂·t_i)，∂_i∂_jR = −[t_i·t_j−(r̂·t_i)(r̂·t_j)]/R，代入 U=½k_c(R−ℓ0)² 得

  S_ij = k_c[ (r̂·t_i)(r̂·t_j)(1+ε/R) − (ε/R)(t_i·t_j) ]。

若两力臂切向共线（τ2=±τ1，cosψ=r̂·τ，s=sign(τ1·τ2)）：

  S_ij = s · B · k_c ℓ_i ℓ_j ,  B = cos²ψ(1+ε/R) − ε/R ,

对角与非对角拿到同一个 B。B 的性质：

- 稳定性（两态、环宽为正）要求 B>0 ⇔ ε < R·cot²ψ。
- B≤1 恒成立，等号当且仅当 ψ=0（力臂垂直于弹簧轴，即力矩臂最大、切向与弹簧轴平行）；此时 B=1 与 ε 完全无关。
- 于是 ε 只能整体缩放该边，不能把宽度通道与场通道推向相反方向。

由 h_i 与 b_i 的定义，b_i ∝ 2S_ijθ_j/(k_dL)、Δh_i ∝ S_iiθ_i/(k_dL)（同一驱动几何因子），秩一即给出

  b1·b2 = 4·Δh1·Δh2  （θ、k_c、k_d、ε 全消去），  以及  b1/b2 = θ2/θ1。

## 3. 哪些旧命题作废、哪些被替代

- 作废（我上轮自己的）：『预压项在 ∂_i∂_jR 与 ∂_i²R 上异号，因此宽度与场反向移动，可作判读』。代数上二者是同一 B 的两个位置，任何 ε 都同向缩放；且该判读所依赖的幂差本身在分辨率内不存在。
- 作废：『平移列幂 2.22 比宽度更陡，所以 κ 只统宽度』。
- 替代：秩一 ⇒ 两列是同一因子 B 的两个权重（θ_i 与 θ_j）；『通道可分』= 边 Hessian 秩≥2，即同一对转子上要有两簧且切向奇偶相反（或切向不共线）。
- 保留并加强：单簧边无非可规范符号，因此单簧网络无挫折；符号 s 是几何奇偶，不是材料属性。

## 4. 振幅（条件性）

λ = N·B·k_cℓ²/(k_dL)。取 N=2、k_c=名义（pair_A 0.07、pair_B 0.19）、k_d=0.19 N/cm、L=6.3 cm：

- pair_A（ℓ=4.731，λ≈3.36）：B_obs=1.28
- pair_B（ℓ=4.7，λ≈8.40）：B_obs=1.20

两台独立装置给出同一个数 ≈1.2，且都在单簧几何上限 B≤1 之上 20–30%。唯一自然的吸收项是『装机弹簧刚度 ≈1.2–1.3× 标定样本名义值』——这正是 data_dictionary 已写明的保留（标定样本不是每根装机弹簧的身份）。若 N=1，则 pair_A 需 B=2.57（几何上不可能），除非 mount_l 不是力矩臂。故数据在 N=2 的读法下自洽；N 本身仍是反推量，不是案件事实。

## 5. 局限

- 手算复算（analyze_csv 不支持行切片，未能用工具复核）；未做误差传播。
- 假设 Δh 与 b 的驱动几何因子相同（同一 k_dL 与同一线性化）。
- mount_l 是否即各转子自己的力矩臂、两转子臂长是否相等：unknown；宽度比 4.33 对 θ 比 3.49 差 24%，若臂长相等则是一处未解释残差（等价于 ℓ1/ℓ2≈1.11）。
- ψ 只能由振幅反推，耦合安装点坐标不在表内。
- 秩一/可规范在文献中的地位：本轮检索全失败，仍 unknown。

先复算：把 pair_A 的 32 个 threshold 行按 (rotor, direction, other_state, ℓ) 分组，得 h_i=(up−down)/2 与 b_i=[Δup+Δdown]/2，四点 h1=7.20/6.85/6.00/4.60、h2=1.70/1.60/1.45/1.10，b1=−0.10/−0.60/−1.20、b2=−0.40/−1.90/−4.40。逐点对纯 ℓ² 的偏差 0.03–0.10 cm，正好是一格分辨率；上一轮 1.63 对 2.22 的幂差是把 0.1 cm 量级的差取对数斜率得到的，属于小量噪声，不是机制指纹。这一步是对我自己上轮主结论的否定。(2) 再推导：写全 U=½k_c(R−ℓ0)² 的 Hessian。因为 a_i=∂_iR=−(r̂·t_i)、∂_i∂_jR=−[t_i·t_j−(r̂·t_i)(r̂·t_j)]/R、∂_i²R=−[|t_i|²−(r̂·t_i)²]/R，得 S_ij=k_c[(r̂·t_i)(r̂·t_j)(1+ε/R)−(ε/R)(t_i·t_j)]。关键观察：对角与非对角只差把 (r̂·t_j) 换成 (r̂·t_i)，两者共用同一个括号里的 B；因此『预压项让对角与非对角异号』在代数上不可能——它只能让三项一起变号（那正是两态稳定性边界 B=0），或一起缩放。当两切向共线时 S_ij=s·B·k_cℓ_iℓ_j 严格秩一，s=sign(τ1·τ2)。(3) 把 h、b 的定义代回：h_i=θ_i(S_ii+k_dL²)/(k_dL) 的耦合部分 ∝ S_iiθ_i，b_i ∝ 2S_ijθ_j，故秩一给出 b1b2=4Δh1Δh2 与 b1/b2=θ2/θ1，θ、k_c、k_d、ε 全部消去。实测 0.95、0.85；b1/b2=0.273 对 θ2/θ1=0.287（5%）。这一步把『两通道是否独立』变成可判：判据通过 ⇒ 单簧（或奇偶相同的多簧）边根本只有一个数；要两个独立旋钮，必须秩≥2，即同一对转子上两簧切向奇偶相反。(4) 两条由此掉出来的后果。第一条：符号不再是装配标签，而是几何奇偶 s。pair_A 的 b<0 ⇒ s=−1 ⇒ 两耦合臂在各自枢轴上取相反朝向；pair_B 的 b>0 ⇒ 同侧。这与案件里仍 unknown 的『两簧安装侧别』正面相接，是可被否掉的预言。第二条：λ 有上限 N k_cℓ²/(k_dL)（因为 B≤1），实测比值在两台独立装置上都是 1.2，说明装机 k 约为标定名义的 1.2–1.3 倍，而且 ψ≈0——恰好是 B=1 与 ε 无关的那个构型。这解释了一件此前困惑的事：为什么 ε 的符号在这张表里读不出来，不是数据不够，而是该构型下预压对阈值的效应被 cos²ψ 与 −ε/R 精确抵消。(5) 算不下去的地方（保留）：宽度比 Δh1/Δh2=4.33 对 θ 比 3.49 差 24%，若两臂等长则秩一预测应更接近 3.49，等价于 ℓ1/ℓ2≈1.11；但 repair_context.content:
Use only the tools exposed for this stage. Use read_documents to batch several needed pages in one call, avoiding repeated model round-trips. Use the supplied stage-scoped catalog; do not read arbitrary paths or earlier runs. The originating study and its explanations remain hidden. For case units, definitions or processing facts, use request_case_definition; an isolated service releases only reviewed neutral facts with opaque evidence IDs. General literature retrieval remains restricted to independently dated earlier sources. You may reason conditionally while a case fact remains unknown. Use search_sources for actual missing public knowledge; returned access depth is explicit, not proof of relevance. analyze_csv reads every selected row, not the 12-row preview. Submit once using submit_result; if validation fails, the draft is saved locally. Use patch_result with the latest draft_ref and only changed fields; do not regenerate unchanged text. Original submissions remain archived. Every result requires summary (nonempty string) and artifacts, evidence, claims, limitations, next_actions (arrays, empty allowed), plus stage-specific fields. For development_step focus/uptake source, use a supplied source ID, document ID or unambiguous registered filename. Use a source-field locator instead of copying an exact quote when convenient. A registered document ID/path suffices if no specific field is selected; optional paraphrases are stored separately from exact quotes. For a JSON source, quote the exact string VALUE, without adding its field name. Alternatively supply quote_pointer (JSON pointer to a string) and omit quote; the exact selected string will be resolved and logged. For learning_request, context_ref="development_step" may replace duplicate gap/why_now strings; this references your own gap/reason, never changes its content. For sources[].local_path use the returned D-document ID to avoid copying long paths; it resolves to the exact registered file. source_use covers exactly broker_reply_source_ids, not the whole source catalog or new searches in this turn. Cite newly read tool sources in evidence/memory_notes with actual paths/URLs. Keep result text concise; use 0-1 useful memory notes unless multiple are necessary. Preserve branches and open issues. files is an object of relative artifact paths to complete text content; every declared artifact must exist or be provided in files. If artifacts is empty, your exact summary is saved automatically as an artifact; do not repeat the entire JSON as prose. For review-index-v2, start with the stage directory and read relevant result/before-input sections by document ID. Summaries are incomplete navigation excerpts, not evidence. Start with input_refs and inline bodies, not the entire provenance catalog. When reading a needed document, request the relevant JSON pointer or a useful page (up to 12000 characters); avoid repeated tiny probes. For review, source_stage must match the stage containing the exact quote; note_keys are actual memory_notes keys (often empty), not JSON field names. If an input body is omitted or represented by $document, read it by ID. No scientific text was summarized; originals and before-inputs remain readable. Online retrieval is enabled.

Execute agent_learn.md's learning and co-questioning plan. Chinese readable artifacts.
Do not read earlier project runs/candidates. Only use listed inputs, their cited source files,
the current case's exchanges, supplied memory, and public sources. A previous task is accessible
only through the supplied memory packet and its provenance. Do not scan old run directories.
Read the actual common sources behind summaries. Treat published findings as published knowledge.
Do not present them as discoveries. Preserve disagreements and all idea branches.
Use public sources via urllib/curl (Crossref, Europe PMC, PMC, arXiv, publishers as accessible).
Save retrieved text and exact URLs; distinguish full text, abstract and failed access.
No solving, scientific validation experiment, proof or novelty gate is required for ideas.
Small worked calculations are allowed to learn a concept, clearly labelled learning examples.
Save result.json with the six runtime fields plus the requested fields. Use summary as a STRING.
Do not spend your entire budget retrieving; save useful partial understanding if needed.
Study your actual controller reply. Identify directly relevant sources, transferable methods and irrelevant results; explain what changes in your assumption and what remains open. Classify every returned source; not_read is valid for sources not studied. Return source_use:[{source_id,relation:direct/method/irrelevant/not_read,reason}], learning_change, and an optional next learning_request. Label hypothetical worked examples. 
Also return memory_notes: 0-3 reusable notes; [] when unchanged. Each object has:
key (stable lower_case ASCII concept key; reuse an existing key when correcting it), title,
kind (source_knowledge/interpretation/hypothesis/correction),
mastery (read/explained/used; identify how the knowledge informed actual research when used),
understanding, conditions, open_questions (nonempty strings), optional example (text or null),
tags (array, include English and Chinese terms), sources (array of actual URLs or source paths),
revision_reason (required when the key already exists).
Separate published knowledge, your inference and untested hypotheses. 'Unknown' is a valid
open_questions string, never invent competence. Describe corrections explicitly.
Also return memory_use: array of {key,source_task,used_for,scope_check} for notes actually used;
return [] if none. State what you still cannot explain/use.

After studying the reply, reconsider the next move and any expertise request. 
Develop an unfinished explanatory hypothesis using the supplied actual research history.
Select a useful operation: derive, construct, combine, simplify, vary_assumption, reframe,
differentiate, learn, or hold. Carry out the operation: explain the entities, relations,
reasoning and conditional consequences, rather than merely recommend doing it later.
Use development_step.work for the actual reasoning (or a concrete unresolved obstacle).
Use examples only when they advance this reasoning; memory use needs no demonstration.
A shared interpretation is normal. Continue deepening it; do not manufacture disagreement.
If changing representation or borrowing another field, explain the object/relation mapping,
where it fails, and what new relation/consequence it enables. A generic analogy is a lead.
If two prior research outputs are supplied in progress_comparison, compare THEIR substantive
claims, assumptions and consequences, not labels or wording. Return progress_review:
{before_stage,after_stage,kind:advance/clarification/repetition/uncertain,reason}.
These are peer judgments, not verified novelty/quality scores; incomplete ideas remain valid.
For repeated clarification/repetition, choose an appropriate new move or explain specifically
why further work on the same relation is useful. Keep unavailable case facts distinct from
conditional reasoning. You may develop another relation while a fact remains unknown.
Return next_research_move:{action:develop/learn/consult/park/finish,operation,focus,reason,
owner:optional active researcher id}. It determines the next turn, not hypothesis acceptance.
finish means no useful next move within this session; retain unfinished hypotheses.
Optionally return expertise_request:{domain,relation,task,mode:consult/join} when additional
expertise is needed for a SPECIFIC relation. A consultation is one turn; join participates in
later turns. Same-field experts are allowed. Do not add a role merely to increase diversity.
Use the existing hypothesis_updates and provenance machinery. Empty updates are valid.


HYPOTHESIS DEVELOPMENT v3:
Use your disciplinary understanding and screened long-term memory to develop assumptions.
Start from a specific phenomenon, tension, difficulty or missing relation. When you have a
possible explanation or organizing principle, state what you suppose; merely changing a
'whether' question into an affirmative sentence adds no insight. An assumption can be an
explanation, conjectured relation, representation, distinction or method/construction principle.
Explore what conceptual move it makes and, CONDITIONALLY on the assumption, what changes in
our understanding or possible actions. Develop concrete consequences, not promises of impact.
Use these as thinking moves, not a checklist that every early idea must already satisfy.
Before requesting learning, identify a specific missing conceptual connection in the current
assumption, why it matters, and what understanding might change. Return to that same gap after
reading: explain a revised premise, relation or conditional consequence, or retain the gap.
Do not substitute more citations, caveats, controls or formal wording for conceptual development.
Measurement/method contributions remain valid when their concrete intellectual consequences are
articulated. No compulsory mechanism, scientific breakthrough, or progress at each turn.

In peer discussion, engage a specific assumption: elaborate a consequence, expose a hidden
premise, connect a disciplinary concept, propose a distinct explanation, or revise a relation.
Explain the reasoning. You may retain, revise, branch, or park your own line. No forced consensus,
disagreement, novelty claim, completed hypothesis or compulsory new branch each turn.
Evidence strength, proof, available data/tools, implementation and experimental feasibility
are NOT requirements for proposing, retaining or prioritizing a hypothesis. Do not turn
discussion into a feasibility review. Research/analysis requests remain optional resources
for thinking. Correct concrete errors in premises while keeping conditional hypotheses distinct
from established observations; lack of evidence alone is not a refutation.

hypothesis_state.self contains your saved branches; peer_branches belong to their named owners.
Return hypothesis_updates: [] when nothing changed, otherwise full cards:
{key: stable local identifier [A-Za-z0-9_]+, base_version: 0 for new or supplied own version,
assumption: nonempty provisional claim, motivation: specific phenomenon/difficulty/relation,
conceptual_move: string or null if still unclear,
implications: [specific conditional consequences, may be empty],
open_questions: [unresolved conceptual questions, may be empty],
status: developing/parked, reason: why propose/change/park/resume,
influenced_by: [exact ref objects from supplied hypothesis_state],
depends_on: [exact supplied hypothesis refs used as premises; [] if none]}.
Influence is not logical dependence. Declare depends_on only for actual premises; do not invent
links. revision_obligations lists your branches whose declared premises changed or themselves
await review. This does NOT mean the branch is false. For each obligation return
 dependency_responses:[{ref:exact hypothesis_ref,action:revise/reaffirm/park/unresolved,reason}].
Reaffirm/revise requires an updated full card citing current dependency versions; changing only
links is recorded as provenance maintenance, not conceptual progress. Park/unresolved retains
the branch and its warning. Reasoned reaffirmation is valid; do not mechanically follow criticism.
Dependencies not explicitly declared cannot be inferred by this structural checker.
Omitting a branch retains it. To keep an alternative, use a new key and cite the parent ref;
never overwrite a peer's branch. Missing conceptual_move or implications is allowed for an
early assumption. Keep hypothetical consequences explicitly hypothetical, including examples.
Reusable conceptual learning can also be saved through existing memory_notes, kind:hypothesis,
with actual source provenance and same-key revisions. Run-local branches do not replace your
long-term disciplinary memory or its source screening. Do not invent empirical support.


Optional learning_request: {needed:boolean, gap, why_now, queries:[strings],
urls:[], source_ids:[], record_ids:[], operations:[], case_questions:[]}.
Use case_questions for actual case definitions/units/processing order; literature cannot
reconstruct undocumented case facts. These questions dispatch even when needed:false.
General theory and explanation-development requests use queries/gap. For case facts, the
isolated material service releases supported neutral definitions, not hidden conclusions.
The controller searches and returns actual readable content. Keep your own scientific query;
classify returned sources as directly relevant, transferable method, or irrelevant, with reasons.
Do not treat a successful download as understanding. No compulsory tool use.
For a small worked calculation use an operation {kind:"calculation", question,
bindings:{name: numeric scalar/array}, expression: numeric array expression,
expected: optional numeric value/array}. Available arithmetic, slices and named functions
include mean,sum,std,norm,diff,abs,sqrt. Define which rows/columns mean which entities.
Top-level analysis_plan also dispatches. needed:false disables literature search, not explicit
calculations. Unsupported requests return a pending capability task; no scientific rejection.
Keep purely tentative proposals in hypothesis_updates/next_actions, not execution fields.


HYPOTHESIS CONTENT CYCLE:
Use development_cycle as a thinking context, not a demand to invent progress. Choose one
specific explanatory relation, construction, distinction or unresolved phenomenon from its
sources. Locate the conceptual gap: what connection/premise/consequence is still unclear?
Choose a next move because of this gap: learn, derive, connect, reframe, or hold. Explain why
that move could change understanding. For learning, use this gap in learning_request.gap and
why_now, and formulate targeted queries; do not request a broad survey merely to fill a stage.
In discussion, take up a peer's concrete relation and explain how your discipline extends,
challenges or changes its consequences. Generic agreement about controls or feasibility is
not a substitute; a measurement contribution is valid when its specific consequences matter.
Study returned services against the gap that requested them, including failures and pending
capabilities. Do not call retrieval success learning. If nothing changes, say so and preserve
the gap. Own previous_steps carry unfinished thinking across phases and sessions. When the
controller flags repeated_no_change, reconsider the missing connection, premise, or next
learning move; holding a branch is valid. The flag uses supplied peer content comparisons, not a quality verdict. A shared interpretation is normal.
Return development_step:{focus:{source:exact development_cycle.sources key,quote:exact excerpt},
gap:nonempty text, action:learn/derive/connect/reframe/hold, reason:nonempty text,
expected_change:text or null for hold,
uptake:[{source:exact source key,quote:exact excerpt or null only for unresolved,
effect:revise/extend/challenge/unchanged/unresolved,reason:how this affects the focus,
consequence:conditional consequence or null when none follows}],
outcome:{kind:relation/implication/clarification/unchanged/uncertain,
statement:what changed or did not, remaining_gap:text or null}}.
Account once for EACH service key in required_service_uptake. If peer_sources is nonempty,
engage at least one (unresolved with a reason is valid). Other uptake is optional. Quotes must
come from the named source; for published claims quote readable source content, not metadata.
For relation/implication outcomes, preserve the resulting claim in a hypothesis_update's
assumption or implications. This records an author's proposal, NOT confirmed novelty/progress.
No compulsory new relation, branch, agreement, data, experiment, proof or implementation.


QUESTION STATE PROTOCOL v2:
question_state.self is YOUR authoritative current personal question. peer_questions belong
to their named owners. shared_question is the discussion's current shared question, or null.
Do not reconstruct your prior question from the latest peer message. The controller records
the actual before-state; do NOT return question_before or question_after.
Return personal_question_update: {base: the exact self.ref object, action: retain/revise,
question: your current or revised personal question, reason: a nonempty explanation,
influenced_by: array of exact question ref objects from this supplied packet}.
Retain means the question text stays exactly the same. Revise may include adopting a peer's
line or the shared question: explain why; use influenced_by to identify relevant question refs.
You need not preserve disagreement or a distinct personal question if you decide to change it.
Separately return shared_question_update: null, or {base: the exact shared_question.ref (null
if none yet), action: propose/revise/retain, question: shared question text, reason: nonempty,
influenced_by: array of refs from this packet}. Propose is only for a first shared question.
A shared question is a versioned proposal, not proof of peer agreement. Revising it NEVER
changes another researcher's personal question. Your own personal update is independent too.

Use controller-owned question_state, never invent question_before/question_after.
Keep hypotheses tied to specific entities/relations in this situation. A measurement or representation contribution is legitimate; explain its concrete consequences without forcing a natural mechanism.

The models are mostly seen as phenomenological or mathematical tools but can also be related to friction-like pinning of domain-wall motions, where Rayleigh's law of magnetic hysteresis can be seen as the simplest case on either the play model or the Preisach model. They are poor at modeling other domain behavior, such as nucleation-driven hysteresis. Yet another hysteresis model is the stop model, which can be seen as the inverted version of the play model. This type of model has advantages for expressions linked to energy and can be related to Steinmetz equation of hysteresis losses.
